requirements.note: Accredited bachelor’s degree required; no minimum GPA. Unofficial U.S. transcripts accepted for review. Interviews January/February; decisions mid/late-February. No prior supervisor commitment required.

funding.note: Each accepted PhD student receives full tuition, fees and health insurance. Published New York stipend is for 2026–2027; Fall2027 amount unconfirmed.

summary: Weill Cornell's Pharmacology PhD is one of the graduate school's six PhD programs. Thesis research is typically completed within four to six years.
